thought.text: Let me fix both package.json files:

reasoning_content: The changes to package.json didn't take effect because PM2 cached the old config. Also there are TWO package.json files - one in root (/root/opt/areloria/package.json) and one in server (/root/opt/areloria/server/package.json). Let me check and fix both.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 -c '
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check root package.json
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n \"type\" /root/opt/areloria/package.json | head -3")
print("=== Root package.json type ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Delete all PM2 processes and start fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pkill -f areloria")

# Fix server package.json
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n \"type\" /root/opt/areloria/server/package.json | head -3")
print("\\n=== Server package.json type ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Fix both
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '/\"type\": \"module\"/d' /root/opt/areloria/package.json && sed -i '/\"type\": \"module\"/d' /root/opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("Removed type: module from both")

# Start fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 start /root/opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 5 && pm2 list")
print("\\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
'
